title: Motor vehicle recycler licence
summary: This page provides information on obtaining, renewing, or checking a motor vehicle recycler licence in New South Wales.

internal_links.text: Apply for a motor vehicle recycler licence
Renew a motor vehicle recycler licence
Check a motor vehicle recycler licence
Change the details of a motor dealer, recycler or repairer premises

faqs.q: How do I apply for a motor vehicle recycler licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a motor vehicle recycler licence using the dedicated application page.

faqs.q: How do I renew my motor vehicle recycler licence?
faqs.a: You can renew your licence through the online renewal service.

faqs.q: How can I check the status of a motor vehicle recycler licence?
faqs.a: You can check the status of a licence using the online check service.
